title: WCLAP Rack document
description: A wclap-rack v1 document: an ordered serial chain of WCLAP audio-effect devices, each referencing a bundle by MANIFEST key. See SPEC.md.

source.description: Optional instrument device at the head of the rack: rendered from notes (no audio input), its output feeds the device chain. Without it, the host supplies the input audio.

length.description: frames of audio to render when the caller gives no input audio (default 48000)

kind.description: optional non-normative hint: 'sampler' (files include an .sfz), 'synth' (generated DSP), … — lets wasm-less hosts fall back to a native player (SPEC §8)

files.description: files the source (engine) plugin needs, delivered before activate via wclap.files/1 or a preopen (SPEC §8)

path.description: path inside the module's file system

archive.description: path inside the rack bundle archive

frame.description: note-on frame, relative to the start of the audio (after preRoll)

frames.description: note length in frames; default: until the end of the rendered audio

bundle.description: MANIFEST key of the WCLAP bundle

plugin.description: clap plugin id inside the bundle

params.description: clap param id (string) or name -> raw CLAP value within [min, max]; applied at frame 0 of the device's render

state.description: base64 clap.state blob, loaded before params
